about_the_game:
Expand your universe with the EVERSPACE 2 Official Soundtrack - Expansion Tracks! This album collects music from the EVERSPACE 2: Titans and EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients expansions, bringing stellar beats and dark celestial synth to your playlist.

Experience 25 tracks totalling more than 54 minutes of music in FLAC and mp3 format, rearranged and remixed by ROCKFISH Games Composer and Sound Director Gero Goerlich and Senior Sound Designer Lukas Deuschel!

content_descriptors.notes: EVERSPACE 2 is a space shooter-looter game with a sci-fi storyline and mature themes. It contains language, mild blood, mild suggestive themes and violence suitables for 12+ ages and above.
